changes.reason: Adding the d shell to s+p raises num_wann from 4 to 9, fewer than the 12 kept bands. It gives the functions the d character of the Na states above E_F that s+p could not represent.
Keeps exact reproduction through E_F+2 eV and beyond (the eta_2 weight region) while staying below band 8's minimum (4.67 eV). It is well inside capacity for 9 functions.

diagnosis: On the construction mesh the subspace reproduces the parent exactly (about 1e-5 eV below the frozen edge). On the separate path, eta_2 is 71 meV, with errors of about 170 meV even in the fully frozen band 5 near Γ. So the failure comes from interpolation, not from subspace selection. The real-space Hamiltonian is long-ranged (decay length 2.9 Å, 1.3 % of |H|² beyond 10 Å), the gauge is non-smooth, and the wannierisation diverged. Na's s+p set (3s + 3p, 4 functions) cannot represent the d-mixed states that a wider frozen window pins. Widening dis_froz_max helped only slightly (41 → 37 meV), then broke the minimisation and doubled the error at 5.5 eV, which is close to the frozen-capacity limit of 5.68 eV. The pseudopotential has no d orbital, so PDWF cannot widen its projector set. Switching to SMV with analytic s, p and d (9 functions out of 12 kept bands) and a frozen window at E_F+4 eV gives the subspace the d character it needs and leaves the frozen window well inside capacity.

band_interpolation_eta2.note: eta_2 = 2.46 meV at mu = E_F(scf) + 2 = 3.555 eV over 270 path k-points and 9 bands
band_interpolation_eta2.insulator_rule: no band crosses E_F on the mesh and gap >= sigma = 0.1 eV
